name: One-Pot Soup or Stew
equipment: A large pot or Dutch oven
instructions: Brown protein and saute aromatics directly in the pot first to build a flavorful base before adding liquid.
Add broth or water along with your heartiest vegetables (root vegetables, beans) first, since they take longest to soften.
Simmer, partially covered, until everything is tender -- resist a hard boil, which can toughen meat.
Add quicker-cooking vegetables or greens in the last 5-10 minutes so they do not turn to mush.
